notes:
Inbound SMB (SaaS support product). Mostly self-serve but legal engagement early. CRM-style notes below:
- "Customer profile": 80 people prod support, growing fast; building conversational FAQ + ticket summarization.
- Prefers hosted API (no private deployment) — quoted: "Don't want infra overhead; must be plug-and-play."
- Security asks: SOC2 Type II evidence, DPA signed, full sub-processor disclosure, SSO (SAML) for team portal, audit logs for token usage.
- Cost sensitivity: prefers predictable per-message pricing; asked about committed discounts for 100k calls/mo.
- Performance: initial measurements: median latency ~190ms, p50 180ms, p95 420ms (during burst). Wants <200ms p95 in production for chat routes.
- Data handling: they will send PII in support transcripts; need clarity on retention and deletion APIs and backups (are backups encrypted & regionally stored?).
- Legal: "they need DPA signed and SOC2 summary before buying" — procurement timeline 4-6 weeks if docs OK.
- Technical: planning a small POC (3 agents) using hosted API. SE asked for sample batching/timeout recommendations; aim to test KV cache + prefix caching.
- Action items: send SOC2 summary + redwood DPA draft (Ethan 3/13), request sub-processor list from security (Marta in parallel), provide performance tuning doc and cost estimate for trial volume.
- Notes from call ff-2026-03-09-8472: customer does not want to manage keys early; prefers Redwood-managed keys with option to move to KMS later.
- Internal risk: small account but legal demands could set precedent; track escalation if sub-processor list includes 3rd-party telemetry vendors.
- Quote from Head of Ops: "If you can show SOC2 + simple DPA, we'll convert trial to paid within month."
short_description: Early inbound SMB lead (Scarlet Dune Labs). Self-serve signup -> discovery. Hosted API preferred; legal requests SOC2/DPA/sub-processor list. SE engaged to help with perf tuning and POC.
